piece_type: Google.com sponsored link (also Bad Ad Program complaint)

cases.claim: “ CONTRAVE® Weight Loss - (naltrexone HCl/bupropion HCl)” | “Lose 2-4x more weight on average than with diet and exercise alone!” | “View Important Safety Info & Boxed Warning,”
cases.context: Boxed warning for suicidal thoughts and behaviors.
cases.rationale: Efficacy claims with no risk information; link to ISI does not mitigate.
cases.check: Rule: sponsored links with efficacy claims require risk info; 'View ISI' links are not risk information.

cases.cat: Broadening of indication / omission of material indication information
cases.claim: “ CONTRAVE® Weight Loss” | “Lose 2-4x more weight on average than with diet and exercise alone!”
cases.context: Indication: adjunct to reduced-calorie diet and increased physical activity; BMI ≥30, or ≥27 with comorbidity; limitations of use.
cases.rationale: Omits adjunct use, BMI criteria, comorbidity requirement and limitations of use.
cases.check: Rule: weight-management claims must state adjunct-to-diet-and-exercise and BMI criteria.

cases.claim: “Lose 2-4x more weight on average than with diet and exercise alone!”
cases.context: Selectively uses favorable co-primary endpoint (% change in body weight); responder rate (≥5% at 1 yr) 36–57% vs 17–43% placebo.
cases.rationale: Selective presentation of favorable data; implies clinically meaningful effect for any loss.
cases.check: Rule: when PI has co-primary endpoints, flag claims that present only the more favorable one; flag 'Nx more' ratio framing.
